proposal.title: Balance experimental format exploration in engagement engine tie-breaker
proposal.reason: Diagnostics show Experiment A ('CHOICE') was selected 8 times while Experiments B through H had only 1 sample each. When engagement metrics are unpopulated or tied at 0.0, calling max() on the experiment list systematically selected index 0 (Experiment A). Adding a sample-count tie-breaker ensures each format receives at least 3 samples before greedy selection, building sufficient statistical evidence across all interactive format hypotheses.
